title: Barrel Disguise
intro: Barrel Disguise is a consumable item in V Rising. The crafting recipe becomes available after defeating Baron du Bouchon the Sommelier, and it can be crafted using the Woodworking Bench. When used, after a short channeling time, it disguises the player while consuming the item. It has the effect of significantly reducing enemy aggro range and player movement speed, while also granting immunity to sunlight during its usage. Utilizing Waygates or interacting within your territory doesn't break the disguise, but taking damage or interacting with structures like chests and containers outside of yo
description: Disguise yourself as a Barrel, significantly reduces aggro range but reduces movement speed. You can perform a barrel roll stunning any enemy that you roll into. Rolling into a solid object stuns you instead. Taking any damage breaks the effect. Produced at a Woodworking Bench.

title: Blood Coating
intro: Blood Coating is a crafted consumable item. It does not stack with other imbuements. The most recently consumed one will override the other. In the 1.1 October patch its damage was increased to 50% from 40%, and the Blood Orb can no longer be picked up by enemy players. It will instead be "greyed out". Blood Orbs restore 7.5% of the player's max health and bypass the in-combat healing cap.
description: Imbue your equipped weapon with the essence of blood. Your next primary attack inflicts and , dealing 50% magic damage after 2s and spawning a Blood Orb. The on hit effect recharges every 12s and the imbuement lasts for 60 minutes. Effect persists through death.

title: Blood Merlot
intro: Blood Merlot is a consumable item in V Rising. It is an improved, more economical version of Blood Potion as it does less harm to the prisoner's health and misery percentages. The crafting recipe becomes available after defeating Baron du Bouchon the Sommelier. To craft a Blood Merlot, players need to harvest blood from prisoners confined within a Prison Cell. The potion retains the blood quality and type of the tapped prisoner at the expense of 25% to 50% of their health and a 5% to 15% increase in their misery. When consumed it fully replenishes one's blood pool with a corresponding quality
description: A bloody brew mixed with bitter-sweet grapes. Tap a prisoner of blood at the cost of -25% ~ -50% health. Increases misery by +5% ~ +15%.

title: Blood Potion
intro: Blood Potion is a consumable item in V Rising. To craft a Blood Potion, players need to harvest blood from prisoners confined within a Prison Cell. The potion retains the blood quality and type of the tapped prisoner at the expense of 30% to 60% of their health and a 10% to 20% increase in their misery. When consumed it fully replenishes one's blood pool with a corresponding blood quality and type. Can be mixed with other Blood Potions at the Blood Homogenizer.
description: Tap a prisoner on blood at the cost of -30% ~ -60% health. Increases misery by +10% ~ +20%.

title: Blood Rose Brew
intro: Blood Rose Brew is a crafted consumable item. It can be purchased from the Shady Herb & Potion Dealer for Copper Coins.
description: A brew that recovers 40% of your maximum health over 10s. The healing effect is limited when in combat and breaks upon taking damage.

title: Dueling Banner
intro: Dueling Banner is a unique item used for initiating duels, also known as Contests between 2 players. It can be initiated most places in the open world, and in player territories. Contests are risk-free, as instead of dying when your health is reduced to 0, you're instead restored to max health, meaning you do not drop a death bag or drain your Blood Pool / durability. The winner of the contest will be visually crowned temporarily. Is available on both PvE and PvP servers.
description: A placeable banner that allows you to initiate a duel against another player. Crafted from Inventory.

title: Dusk Caller
intro: Dusk Caller is a crafted consumable item. It allows you to summon a swarm of bats to transport a subdued human back to the nearest unoccupied Prison Cell within your realm. Can only be used while Dominate is active. If you're in a clan, it will transport the human to nearest unoccupied prison cell within all your castles. If you'd like to ensure the target is transported to a specific prison cell, make sure that cell is the only unoccupied one at the time.
description: Summon a swarm of bats to transport a subdued human back to the nearest unoccupied prison cell within your realm. Produced at an Alchemy Lab.

title: EMP
intro: EMP is a deployable item akin to Major Explosive Box. One is required to disable the electrified gate and door of Doctor Blackbrew's Castle, where Adam the Firstborn is held. It is possible to fly over the gate using Bat Form to save an EMP, but the door must be disabled. It can also be used to stun machine enemies such as Lightning Protectors, but cannot be placed near POIs.
description: A device that triggers an electro magnetic pulse when struck. Can be used to temporarily disable electrical sources.

title: Irradiant Gruel
intro: Irradiant Gruel is a crafted consumable item. It increases the blood quality of a prisoner by +1% ~ +2%, but has a 35% chance to turn the prisoner into a raging mutant. The Mutant created will always be the mutant Abomination and cannot be dominated. If a prisoner is transformed into an abomination, it must be killed.
description: A brew with blood-mutating effects. Not recommended to drink.

title: Major Explosive Box
intro: The Major Explosive Box is a recipe obtained from Angram the Purifier. This is the second raiding method players get access to. It is used to destroy stone structures by moving it to the hotbar and placing it down. Once the fuse is lit by any weapon attack or spell, including enemy attacks, it will explode after 3 seconds. It does 40% of a structure's max health in damage, meaning it requires 3 boxes to fully destroy a structure. Note that explosives can only damage stone structures after they have been breached by a Siege Golem Stone. It can also be used for mining large resource deposits loc
description: A box full of explosives, handle with care. Can be used to destroy Massive Resource Veins, Walls and Doors. More powerful against castle walls.

title: Minor Explosive Box
intro: The Minor Explosive Box is a recipe obtained from Clive the Firestarter. This is the first raiding method players get access to. It is used to destroy wooden structures by moving it to the hotbar and placing it down. It is notably used to enter Quincey the Bandit King's stronghold. Once the fuse is lit by any weapon attack or spell, including enemy attacks, it will explode after 3 seconds. It does 20% of a structure's max health in damage, meaning it requires 5 boxes to fully destroy a structure. It can also be used for mining large resource deposits located throughout the map that can't be mi
description: A box full of explosives, handle with care. Can be used to destroy Massive Resource Veins, Walls and Doors.

title: Siege Golem Stone
intro: Siege Golems are used to breach stone castles. Each siege golem attack on a castle triggers the "Castle Under Attack" status effect for 1 minute. Disabling Castle Teleporters and the ability to repair structures or interact with Servant Coffins to revive Servants. Once a Castle Wall / Door has been destroyed, it triggers the "Breached" status effect for 8 minutes. All structures now take damage from by all sources including Major Explosive Box, and the damage is multiplied by 4 for the duration. Finally, any newly placed structure is fragile for a few seconds after being built, able to be dest
description: Place the Siege Stone in an uncontested location. It takes 150s for the stone to activate. When activated you can interact with it to transform into a Siege Golem for up to 300s allowing you to break into stone structures. You can absorb a set amount of damage before the form breaks, the amount of damage you can absorb scales based on the health of the Siege Stone. Depending on server settings the placement of a Siege Stone may be announced to other players and may be visible for everyone on the map.
